# Attachment

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Attachment")`

A named place on a part: a socket to weld something to, a joint frame for a constraint, a muzzle to spawn something at. It has no body and is not simulated -- what it costs is one transform per tick, and a world with none pays nothing.

It is not on `PVInstance`, deliberately: an attachment is a thing you make and name, and giving every part an invisible one would make "where is this attached" ambiguous in exactly the cases it needs to be clear.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read/write | Where this sits relative to the part it is parented to. |
| `WorldCFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read-only | Where that lands in the world, recomputed each tick.<br><br>Read-only because a world transform that could be assigned would be a second source of truth about the same place: the part moves, and whatever was written here would be either overwritten or wrong. |
